Runway AI Video Generator: Free Credits and First Video

Runway Free includes 125 one-time credits, and free videos have a watermark. If your workspace offers Gen-4 Turbo at the published 25-credit rate, you can plan up to five 5-second attempts with a full balance. Check the model and cost shown before generating. Gen-4.5 text-to-video requires Standard or higher.

  1. Choose a trial route
  2. Budget 5- and 10-second attempts
  3. Make and check one short clip
  4. Check an upgrade prompt
  5. Sources and test scope

What are you starting with?

See stepsSee stepsSee steps

Budget short clips and retries

Start with the actual balance in your Runway workspace. Enter planned generations, including retries. Runway’s Gen-4 help page lists 25 credits for five seconds and 50 for ten on Turbo. If the panel lists a different cost, replace the corresponding preset below.

Edit credit costs per attempt

At the listed rates, one 5-second and one 10-second attempt cost 75 credits. From 125, that leaves 50 for two more short attempts or one more long attempt. Use the result to plan generations. The number of usable clips depends on the outputs.

Animate one image and check the export

  1. Open Runway and check the model selector in the Video tool. If Gen-4 Turbo is available, use an image you have permission to upload. You can download our 16:9 synthetic test image for a simple practice shot.
  2. Describe one change in motion, such as “Slow camera push toward the mug, with the mug centered and its shape steady.” Inspect the crop before generating. If you need a vertical deliverable, check whether the new crop cuts off the subject.
  3. Select five seconds first, confirm the displayed credits and generate once. Compare the credit balance and save the output if you need to inspect it outside Runway.
  4. Play the whole download. Check the framing, whether the subject stays recognizable, the actual duration and the watermark. If the motion fails, change one part of the prompt and recalculate before retrying.

Start from text with Gen-4.5

For a text-only Runway shot, choose Gen-4.5 in the Video model list when your workspace includes it. Runway lists Standard or higher, 2–10 seconds and 12 credits per second for regular video. A five-second generation costs 60 credits at that rate. Confirm the delivery settings and the displayed cost before generating.

If you need to compare paid options or budget a different duration or model, use the AI video plan comparison and per-attempt calculator.

Check access if the model is missing or asks you to upgrade

Make sure you are using the intended workspace. Free access includes a changing selection of models, and credits do not refill after the one-time allocation is spent. If the tool asks for an upgrade, check whether the selected model is on your plan and whether the balance covers the displayed cost.

If you only need to test image motion before choosing a plan, the free image-to-video guide includes a separately verified guest trial and download. Check the selected service’s current terms and watermark before using an output publicly.

Sources and test scope

Checked November 28, 2026. See Runway’s Free plan details, Gen-4 video settings, and Gen-4.5 settings. The public pricing page’s Standard-plan Turbo capacity example differs from the Gen-4 help rate. Use the current generation panel as the final check.
